'''Kit Fowler''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''The Last Call''' in the '''Capoya''' system. A technically gifted conspiracy broadcaster, he funds his independent ''End Times'' programme through engineering work.<ref name="inara-kit">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/29/ Kit Fowler — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, services, and referral record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="fandom-kit">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Kit_Fowler Kit Fowler], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game biography. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

Kit is the second Engineer in the Domino Green branch and provides the direct referral to [[Yarden Bond]].

The Last Call is a surface Engineer base on Capoya 2, approximately 434 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-last-call">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/275875/ The Last Call — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Domino Green]] after providing her with '''5 doses of Push'''.
|-
| Unlock
| Sell '''5 Opinion Polls''' to bartenders.
|}

Push is Domino's referral item; Opinion Polls are Kit's separate unlock requirement. Frontier reduced the Opinion Poll requirement from ten to five in Update 18.08.<ref name="inara-kit" /><ref name="frontier-1808">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-0-18-08 Type-8 Update Release Notes (18.08)], Frontier Developments; updated Engineer unlock requirements. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref> The material-acquisition workflow and preceding shuttle requirement belong to [[Unlocking Kit Fowler]].

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-kit" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering ==

Kit installs individual modifications into available suit and handheld-weapon modification slots. His services do not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression, blueprint rolls, Experimental Effects, or Remote Engineering used for ship modules. Equipment grade and modification-slot availability are handled through the wider [[Odyssey Engineering]] system.

== Engineering services ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Purpose
|-
| Added Melee Damage
| Suit
| Increases damage from fists and weapon melee attacks.
|-
| Extra Ammo Capacity
| Suit
| Increases the ammunition carried for each equipped weapon.
|-

| Suit
| Speeds personal-shield regeneration.
|-
| Magazine Size
| Handheld weapon
| Increases the weapon's magazine capacity.
|-
| Stowed Reloading
| Handheld weapon
| Automatically reloads the weapon while it is stowed.
|}

These five modification types are available once Kit is unlocked, subject to compatible equipment, an open modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits.<ref name="inara-kit" /> Their complete recipes, detailed effects, and cross-Engineer availability belong to [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]].

== Referral to Yarden Bond ==

After unlocking Kit, provide him with '''5 units of Surveillance Equipment''' to discover [[Yarden Bond]]. This referral item is separate from the Opinion Polls used to unlock Kit.<ref name="inara-kit" /><ref name="inara-yarden">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/33/ Yarden Bond — Engineer], INARA; current discovery prerequisite. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

<pre>
Domino Green
└── Kit Fowler
    └── Yarden Bond
</pre>

Yarden's own unlock conditions belong on [[Yarden Bond]] and in [[Unlocking Yarden Bond]].
